metadata.mechanism: output-restricted sensitivity-operator pullback: an isotropic RBF in the coordinates S x, S = d|V_far|/dx of shape 45 x 110
metadata.feeder: IEEE PES European LV test feeder (pandapower ieee_european_lv_asymmetric('on_peak_566')), 906 LV buses, 905 lines, 55 single-phase loads on their real phases (21/19/15)
metadata.ground_truth: pandapower runpp_3ph; 220-draw archived ensemble per regime
metadata.folds: 12 seeds x 2 partition schemes = 24 folds per cell

S1.statement: the treatment must beat the best per-fold canonical baseline by >= 20 percent in every one of the 24 folds at n = 80 on the 2.0x regime

S2.statement: the mean paired margin must become positive at a finite n, reported as the interval between adjacent grid sizes, with the full fraction-clearing curve

S3.statement: NOT EVALUABLE INSIDE THIS ARTIFACT: it requires the other four candidates' screen files, which this artifact must not read
S3.reason: needs the other candidates' screen files, which this artifact must not read

mechanism_verdict_summary.interpretation: see far_over_full_ratio for the measured values

headline_claim.what_is_claimed: an isotropic RBF in the coordinates S x, with S the analytic sensitivity of the far-end phase-voltage magnitudes, is far more sample-efficient than a standard stationary kernel, a graph-Laplacian kernel, ridge, an MLP and a tuned LinDistFlow baseline on this feeder
headline_claim.what_is_NOT_claimed: that the OUTPUT RESTRICTION is what carries the kernel -- the mechanism factorial finds the unrestricted full-state operator at least as accurate on far-end targets from n = 40 upward
headline_claim.retained_claim: admittance structure helps, and the analytic zero-AC-solve operator is what supplies it

extended: canonical + b6_mlp, b7_ard, the impedance-weighted Laplacian retained as a demonstration, and the unrestricted 55-dimension admittance Z-bus metric
pools.deliberate_exclusion: the unrestricted 55x55 Z-bus metric is NOT in the canonical pool because it is the full-state metric's load-restricted cousin; including it would let a same-object comparison suppress the treatment's margin.  It appears only in the mechanism section, where it is the point.

breakdown.operator_construction: 0 AC solves with a flat reference voltage; 1 AC solve (no-load) if the no-load reference is adopted
breakdown.ensembles: 0 (archived 660-solve pool reused; 0 if regenerated, see provenance in protocol_checks)

cost_ledger.note: the kernel itself needs no AC solve; the 220-solve identification cost belongs to the ground-truth ensemble, not to the metric

limitations: the bootstrap interval is over SPLITS, not over data: all folds share one 220-draw pool, so the genuinely independent evidence is the untouched regime and the untouched physically-moved-phase feeder, not the seed list

the physically-moved-phase control is NOT run here: it is reserved confirmation evidence for the survivor.  This artifact therefore cannot distinguish 'phase identity matters' from 'phase consistency matters'; the shuffled-label control here is the INCONSISTENCY test, not the identity test
the 2.6x stressed regime is reserved confirmation evidence and was never opened
the paper cannot claim a data-efficiency advantage over neural surrogates across the curve: the MLP is run at n = 80 only
S3 (ranking against the other candidates) is not evaluable inside this artifact
